CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${tableName}` ( `id` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `branch_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `date` DATE DEFAULT NULL, `chart_account_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `location_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `debit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `credit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `customer_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `vendor_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `employee_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `other_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `class_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `chart_account_id` (`chart_account_id`), KEY `company_id` (`company_id`), KEY `location_id` (`location_id`), KEY `date` (`date`) ) ENGINE=MEMORY DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

SELECT grouped.cgroup_id AS id, CASE WHEN cgroups.name IS NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE cgroups.name END AS groupName, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS totalInvoice, SUM(grouped.customer_total) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT totals.customer_id, totals.customer_total, customer_group.cgroup_id FROM ( SELECT records.customer_id, SUM(records.total_amount) AS customer_total FROM ( SELECT invoice.customer_id, (invoice.total_amount - IFNULL(invoice.discount, 0) - IFNULL(invoice.total_deposit, 0)) AS total_amount FROM sales_orders AS invoice WHERE invoice.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND invoice.status > 0
AND DATE(invoice.order_date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(invoice.order_date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY invoice.id, invoice.customer_id UNION ALL SELECT invoice.customer_id, (invoice.total_amount - IFNULL(invoice.discount, 0)) * -1 AS total_amount FROM credit_memos AS invoice WHERE invoice.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND invoice.status > 0
AND DATE(invoice.order_date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(invoice.order_date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY invoice.id, invoice.customer_id ) AS records GROUP BY records.customer_id ) AS totals LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, MIN(cgroup_id) AS cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups GROUP BY customer_id ) AS customer_group ON customer_group.customer_id = totals.customer_id ) AS grouped LEFT JOIN cgroups ON grouped.cgroup_id = cgroups.id GROUP BY grouped.cgroup_id, groupName HAVING SUM(grouped.customer_total) > 0 ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT t.customerId AS customerId, (SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = t.customerId) AS customerName, SUM(t.totalInvoice) AS totalInvoice, SUM(t.totalAmount) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT invoice.customer_id AS customerId, 1 AS totalInvoice, SUM(invoice_detail.total_price - invoice_detail.discount_amount) AS totalAmount FROM sales_orders AS invoice INNER JOIN sales_order_details AS invoice_detail ON invoice.id = invoice_detail.sales_order_id WHERE invoice.status = 2 AND invoice.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY invoice.customer_id UNION ALL SELECT invoice.customer_id AS customerId, -1 AS totalInvoice, SUM(invoice_detail.total_price - invoice_detail.discount_amount) * -1 AS totalAmount FROM credit_memos AS invoice INNER JOIN credit_memo_details AS invoice_detail ON invoice.id = invoice_detail.credit_memo_id WHERE invoice.status = 2 AND invoice.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY invoice.customer_id ) AS t GROUP BY t.customerId HAVING SUM(t.totalAmount) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(t.totalAmount) DESC LIMIT 10

AND MONTH(so.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(so.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})

AND MONTH(so.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(so.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
AND so.branch_id IN

SELECT t.id AS id, (SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = t.id) AS name, SUM(t.totalInvoiceCurrencies) AS totalInvoiceCurrencies FROM ( SELECT sod.product_id AS id, SUM(sod.total_price - sod.discount_amount) AS totalInvoiceCurrencies FROM sales_orders AS so INNER JOIN sales_order_details AS sod ON so.id = sod.sales_order_id WHERE so.status = 2 AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND MONTH(so.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(so.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY sod.product_id UNION ALL SELECT cmd.product_id AS id, SUM(cmd.total_price - cmd.discount_amount) * -1 AS totalInvoiceCurrencies FROM credit_memos AS cm INNER JOIN credit_memo_details AS cmd ON cm.id = cmd.credit_memo_id WHERE cm.status = 2 AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND MONTH(cm.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(cm.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(cm.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(cm.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY cmd.product_id ) AS t GROUP BY t.id HAVING SUM(t.totalInvoiceCurrencies) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(t.totalInvoiceCurrencies) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT cc.id AS id, cc.name AS name, COALESCE(s.sales_total, 0) - COALESCE(cm.cm_total, 0) AS totalInvoiceCurrencies FROM currency_centers cc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.currency_center_id AS cid, SUM(so.total_amount - IFNULL(so.discount, 0)) AS sales_total FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(so.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(so.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(so.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY so.currency_center_id ) s ON s.cid = cc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.currency_center_id AS cid, SUM(cm.total_amount - IFNULL(cm.discount, 0)) AS cm_total FROM credit_memos AS cm WHERE cm.status > 0 AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(cm.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(cm.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(cm.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(cm.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY cm.currency_center_id ) cm ON cm.cid = cc.id WHERE (COALESCE(s.sales_total, 0) - COALESCE(cm.cm_total, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY totalInvoiceCurrencies DESC

SELECT result.parent_group_id AS id, CASE WHEN parent_group.name IS NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE parent_group.name END AS name, result.total_invoice AS totalInvoice, result.total_amount AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT records.parent_group_id, SUM(records.total_invoice) AS total_invoice, SUM(records.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN pg.parent_id IS NULL OR pg.parent_id = 0 OR pg.parent_id = '' THEN pg.id ELSE pg.parent_id END AS parent_group_id, 1 AS total_invoice, SUM(IFNULL(sod.total_price, 0) - IFNULL(sod.discount_amount, 0)) AS total_amount FROM sales_orders AS so INNER JOIN sales_order_details AS sod ON so.id = sod.sales_order_id INNER JOIN product_pgroups AS pp ON pp.product_id = sod.product_id INNER JOIN pgroups AS pg ON pg.id = pp.pgroup_id WHERE so.status = 2 AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND DATE(so.order_date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(so.order_date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY so.id, parent_group_id UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN pg.parent_id IS NULL OR pg.parent_id = 0 OR pg.parent_id = '' THEN pg.id ELSE pg.parent_id END AS parent_group_id, -1 AS total_invoice, SUM(IFNULL(cmd.total_price, 0) - IFNULL(cmd.discount_amount, 0)) * -1 AS total_amount FROM credit_memos AS cm INNER JOIN credit_memo_details AS cmd ON cm.id = cmd.credit_memo_id INNER JOIN product_pgroups AS pp ON pp.product_id = cmd.product_id INNER JOIN pgroups AS pg ON pg.id = pp.pgroup_id WHERE cm.status = 2 AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND DATE(cm.order_date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(cm.order_date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY cm.id, parent_group_id ) AS records GROUP BY records.parent_group_id ) AS result LEFT JOIN pgroups AS parent_group ON parent_group.id = result.parent_group_id WHERE result.total_amount > 0 ORDER BY result.total_amount DESC

SELECT m.m AS month, COALESCE(s.sales_total, 0) - COALESCE(cm.cm_total, 0) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT 1 AS m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(so.order_date) AS m, SUM(so.total_amount - IFNULL(so.discount, 0)) AS sales_total FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND YEAR(so.order_date) = YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(so.order_date) ) s ON s.m = m.m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(cm.order_date) AS m, SUM(cm.total_amount - IFNULL(cm.discount, 0)) AS cm_total FROM credit_memos AS cm WHERE cm.status > 0 AND YEAR(cm.order_date) = YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(cm.order_date) ) cm ON cm.m = m.m WHERE m.m BETWEEN MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) ORDER BY m.m

AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY invoice.vendor_id
UNION ALL
SELECT invoice.vendor_id AS vendorId, -1 AS totalInvoice, SUM(invoice_detail.total_price) * -1 AS totalAmount FROM purchase_returns AS invoice INNER JOIN purchase_return_details AS invoice_detail ON invoice.id = invoice_detail.purchase_return_id WHERE invoice.status >= 0 AND invoice.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND invoice.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(invoice.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(invoice.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY invoice.vendor_id ) AS t GROUP BY t.vendorId HAVING SUM(t.totalAmount) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(t.totalAmount) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT cc.id AS typeMoneyId, cc.name AS typeMoney, COALESCE(po.total_po, 0) - COALESCE(pr.total_pr, 0) AS totalAmount FROM currency_centers cc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.currency_center_id AS cid, SUM(po.total_amount - IFNULL(po.discount_amount, 0)) AS total_po FROM purchase_orders AS po INNER JOIN purchase_requests AS pr ON pr.id = po.purchase_request_id WHERE pr.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND po.status > 0
AND po.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(po.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(po.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(po.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(po.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY pr.currency_center_id ) po ON po.cid = cc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT prr.currency_center_id AS cid, SUM(prr.total_amount) AS total_pr FROM purchase_returns AS prr WHERE prr.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND prr.status > 0
AND prr.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND MONTH(prr.order_date) >= MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(prr.order_date) <= MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) AND YEAR(prr.order_date) >= YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND YEAR(prr.order_date) <= YEAR(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY prr.currency_center_id ) pr ON pr.cid = cc.id WHERE (COALESCE(po.total_po, 0) - COALESCE(pr.total_pr, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT m.m AS month, COALESCE(po.total_po, 0) - COALESCE(pr.total_pr, 0) AS total FROM ( SELECT 1 AS m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(po.order_date) AS m, SUM(po.total_amount - IFNULL(po.discount_amount, 0)) AS total_po FROM purchase_orders po WHERE po.status > 0
AND po.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND YEAR(po.order_date) = YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(po.order_date) BETWEEN MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY MONTH(po.order_date) ) po ON po.m = m.m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(pr.order_date) AS m, SUM(pr.total_amount) AS total_pr FROM purchase_returns pr WHERE pr.status > 0
AND pr.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
AND YEAR(pr.order_date) = YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(pr.order_date) BETWEEN MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY MONTH(pr.order_date) ) pr ON pr.m = m.m WHERE m.m BETWEEN MONTH(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND MONTH(#{filter.dateTo}) ORDER BY m.m

SELECT CONCAT('Q', q.q) AS quarter, COALESCE(s.sales_total, 0) - COALESCE(cm.cm_total, 0) AS actualAmount FROM ( SELECT 1 AS q UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 ) q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CEIL(MONTH(so.order_date) / 3) AS q, SUM(so.total_amount - IFNULL(so.discount, 0)) AS sales_total FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND YEAR(so.order_date) = COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateTo}), COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}), YEAR(CURDATE()))) AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY CEIL(MONTH(so.order_date) / 3) ) s ON s.q = q.q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CEIL(MONTH(cm.order_date) / 3) AS q, SUM(cm.total_amount - IFNULL(cm.discount, 0)) AS cm_total FROM credit_memos AS cm WHERE cm.status > 0 AND YEAR(cm.order_date) = COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateTo}), COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}), YEAR(CURDATE()))) AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY CEIL(MONTH(cm.order_date) / 3) ) cm ON cm.q = q.q ORDER BY q.q

SELECT id AS id, year AS year, amount_q1 AS amountQ1, amount_q2 AS amountQ2, amount_q3 AS amountQ3, amount_q4 AS amountQ4 FROM dashboard_sale_target_settings WHERE company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId}) AND year = COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateTo}), YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom})) AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1;

SELECT CONCAT('Quarter', q.q) AS name, CAST(y.targetYear AS CHAR) AS year, DATE_FORMAT( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.targetYear, '-', CASE q.q WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 2 THEN '04' WHEN 3 THEN '07' ELSE '10' END, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d' ), '%Y-%m-%d') AS monthFrom, DATE_FORMAT( LAST_DAY( DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.targetYear, '-', CASE q.q WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 2 THEN '04' WHEN 3 THEN '07' ELSE '10' END, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 2 MONTH ) ), '%Y-%m-%d') AS monthTo FROM ( SELECT 1 AS q UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 ) q CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateTo}), COALESCE(YEAR(#{filter.dateFrom}), YEAR(CURDATE()))) AS targetYear ) y ORDER BY q.q

SELECT m.m AS month, COALESCE(s.sales_total, 0) - COALESCE(cm.cm_total, 0) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT 1 AS m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 ) AS m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(so.order_date) AS m, SUM(so.total_amount - IFNULL(so.discount,0) - IFNULL(so.total_deposit,0)) AS sales_total FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND YEAR(so.order_date) = YEAR(#{monthFrom}) AND MONTH(so.order_date) BETWEEN MONTH(#{monthFrom}) AND MONTH(#{monthTo}) AND so.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND so.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(so.order_date) ) AS s ON s.m = m.m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(cm.order_date) AS m, SUM(cm.total_amount - IFNULL(cm.discount,0)) AS cm_total FROM credit_memos AS cm WHERE cm.status > 0 AND YEAR(cm.order_date) = YEAR(#{monthFrom}) AND MONTH(cm.order_date) BETWEEN MONTH(#{monthFrom}) AND MONTH(#{monthTo}) AND cm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND cm.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(cm.order_date) ) AS cm ON cm.m = m.m WHERE m.m BETWEEN MONTH(#{monthFrom}) AND MONTH(#{monthTo}) ORDER BY m.m

SELECT result.month, result.parent_group_id, result.parent_group_name, SUM(result.amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT MONTH(po.order_date) AS month, COALESCE(parent.id, pg.id) AS parent_group_id, COALESCE(parent.name, pg.name) AS parent_group_name, SUM(pod.total_cost - pod.discount_amount) AS amount FROM purchase_orders AS po INNER JOIN purchase_order_details AS pod ON po.id = pod.purchase_order_id INNER JOIN product_pgroups AS pp ON pod.product_id = pp.product_id INNER JOIN pgroups AS pg ON pp.pgroup_id = pg.id LEFT JOIN pgroups AS parent ON pg.parent_id = parent.id WHERE po.status = 3 AND po.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND DATE(po.order_date) BETWEEN DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND po.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(po.order_date), COALESCE(parent.id, pg.id), COALESCE(parent.name, pg.name) UNION ALL SELECT MONTH(pr.order_date) AS month, COALESCE(parent.id, pg.id) AS parent_group_id, COALESCE(parent.name, pg.name) AS parent_group_name, SUM(prd.total_price) * -1 AS amount FROM purchase_returns AS pr INNER JOIN purchase_return_details AS prd ON pr.id = prd.purchase_return_id INNER JOIN product_pgroups AS pp ON prd.product_id = pp.product_id INNER JOIN pgroups AS pg ON pp.pgroup_id = pg.id LEFT JOIN pgroups AS parent ON pg.parent_id = parent.id WHERE pr.status = 3 AND pr.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{filter.userId})
AND DATE(pr.order_date) BETWEEN DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND pr.branch_id IN
#{branchId}
GROUP BY MONTH(pr.order_date), COALESCE(parent.id, pg.id), COALESCE(parent.name, pg.name) ) AS result GROUP BY result.month, result.parent_group_id, result.parent_group_name ORDER BY result.month, result.parent_group_name
